title: No more departures today
description: Service has ended for the day: the row list is replaced by a centered message, with a quiet secondary line hinting at tomorrow's first departure so the board doesn't read as broken.

changes.intent: Replace the arrival list with an empty-state message when there are no more scheduled departures today.
changes.detail: Render `.screen__empty` in place of `.arrival-list` containing a primary paragraph 'No hay más salidas programadas por hoy.' and a second, quieter paragraph showing the first departure time tomorrow, e.g. 'Primer bus mañana a las 5:00'.

changes.intent: Center the empty-state message vertically in the card with generous padding so it reads as an intentional state, not missing content.
Show the next-departure hint as a de-emphasized secondary line so it doesn't compete with the primary message.
